name: MxM 404
source:
WILL YOU BE THE FIRST HUMAN TO SURVIVE THIS SHADY JOB AT A SHADY HOTEL IN THE MIDDLE OF NOWHERE? (Spoilers: In this game you won't.)

A sidegame for Monster X Mediator focusing on ONLY room 001. Since the game takes place before the main game, you will NOT survive, there will be NO good endings. Just different bad endings. You can still pick a favourite though!

[From [url=https://headlocker.itch.io/mxm-404]Itch.io[/url]]
